endorsements.quote: Therefore, while it is tempting to bypass this very expensive requirement by relying on large training datasets and the adaptive learning capabilities of these tools, the evidence accumulated so far highlights the need for extensive and formal evaluation of language models against standard clinical practices after they have been trained for specific clinical tasks, such as diagnostic advice and triaging.

unlisted_practices: Train clinical applications of deep-learning language models extensively on expert annotations to reach acceptable standards of clinical performance and reproducibility.
Implement an automated warning triggered by medical-advice queries reminding users that language model outputs do not constitute or replace expert clinical consultation.

Engage all stakeholders (developers, scientists, ethicists, healthcare professionals, providers, patients, advocates, regulators, and government agencies) in identifying the best way forward for language models in healthcare.

screen.reason: Title-only editorial/perspective article questioning the impact and role of ChatGPT in healthcare.
